text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the camp, when I stopped by a beach 
hut to do some quick shopping—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, step right up! Table for one, 
customer? Two? Three dozen?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's a business, obviously! 'Cause this 
beach hut has fallen into the hands of the 
great Gold Ship and crew!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's rank it up to a Grand Ocean Palace 
and rake in so much cash that it gets 
excavated as undersea ruins 564 years from 
now! Right!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, with you by my side, it might not 
just be a pipe dream after all. Shall we 
rewrite the rules... and reshape how 
business is done in this world?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I looked around the shop, but there was no 
clerk in sight. Could she... really have 
taken over the place...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still though, you showed up at just the 
right time! With you around, no one can 
mess with our ocean family!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We've got bonds here that not even 
deep-sea pressure could crush...!! We're 
the strongest family there is!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama is the old man! I'm the 
struggling student! That seagull over 
there is the heroine watching over from 
the shadows, and Trainer is my trusty 
paper cup!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's start developing the 
menu! First off, 1,000x Garam Masala 
Yakisoba is a total must, right, Boss?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Permafrost Shaved Ice, or Full-Bloom 
Anchovy Hype Dango...! Whoa, I'm bursting 
with inspiration, I can't stop!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, fine by me. Go ahead and do 
whatever the hell you want.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing but anxiety in every sense 
of the word... but it's lunchtime. Before 
there was even time to fret, a crowd of 
students came swarming into the beach hut!

text_block_list.name: Customer Students
text_block_list.text:
“Deep-Fried Niagara Fireworks Carpet”, 
“Deep-Sea Ancient Soup”...? What on earth 
are these dishes!? Maybe I should order 
one?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Pardon the intrusion. Golshi's 
yakisoba is delicious, after all... I 
found myself craving it again."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oho, there you are, you stomach monster! 
I'll take you down with Golshi's special: 
1000x Garam Masala Yakisoba!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mmh...?! Wh-What is this...?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...It's delicious!

text_block_list.name: Customer Students
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, even Oguri-senpai approves...! It 
really is delicious! Excuse me, can we get 
one over here too!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Well then, in response to such 
great turnout, it's 564-second service 
time! I'm servin' it up Himalayan-sized, 
baybeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Customer Students
text_block_list.text: Yay! Me too, count me in too—!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Giving that guy free rein really is 
far more interesting."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, that natural friendliness of 
hers... ...is something I have no share 
of.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Pops! Paper cups! Don't just 
stand there dazed, help out! We gotta 
combine the family's strength!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Phew— Ah, hold on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It safely came to an end while still 
packed with excitement! And as we were 
preparing to close up shop—

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um...! Big sisters... Thank you so 
much!"

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
...This is my grandpa's shop. But he 
collapsed from the heat...

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Grandpa said that since everyone from 
Tracen Academy was looking forward to it, 
he couldn't close up shop. He was pushing 
himself to keep the store open.

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
"And then my big sisters told me to leave 
it to them—"
choice_data_list: So that's what was going on...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, cut it out. At the very least, I 
didn't take this on out of pity.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Still... doing something with a 
completely unpredictable wild card who 
might pull anything... just got me 
curious, that's all."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Relying on standard tactics and just 
getting by smoothly... This is far more 
thrilling than anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, look forward to it! Starting 
tomorrow, we're rolling out the 
illuminated Golshi Portable Shrine to draw 
in the crowds!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Amazing! What is that, what is that!?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Seriously, she's about as far from 
the standard playbook as it gets.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Hey. If that's the case, why not combine 
food stalls with the portable shrine and 
make it a mobile beach hut?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds great! I've got some spare 
jet engines lying around, so let's slap 
those on too!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: R-Really!? And then, what happened next!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One bizarre idea led to another... and 
between training camp sessions, the two of 
them ended up working together to liven up 
the beach hut.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—Hold on a sec. We're at the beach, after 
all. If you ask me, an illuminated boat is 
the only way to go.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You can't put caterpillar tracks on a 
ship! That's no good at all!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Then how about we settle this with 
a contest? Caterpillar tracks versus screw 
propellers— let's see which is 
superior...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Two people inspiring and pushing each 
other— thanks to them, the beach hut 
continued to do roaring business from the 
very next day.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa

ideas are interesting, but if you take it 
too far, it's not even gonna look like a 
beach hut anymore."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What the heck, hey! The whole point of it 
being fun is that it keeps evolving, isn't 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I get that you feel indebted to the old 
man running the shop. But hey, leave the 
steering to your "Pops" here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa patted her shoulder to calm 
her down. Thanks to their cooperation, the 
beach hut continued to be a massive hit 
the following day and beyond.
